create_loss_function: create a loss function object such as HalfSquaredError or HalfBinomialLoss for regression or classification tasks
compute_loss_gradient: compute loss and gradient values for given true targets and raw predictions using a loss function
compute_gradient_hessian: compute gradient and hessian arrays for optimization in gradient boosting algorithms
predict_class_probabilities: predict class probabilities from raw predictions using HalfBinomialLoss or HalfMultinomialLoss
get_intercept_only_prediction: compute initial raw predictions for an intercept-only model using fit_intercept_only method
